title: P3.1: Extend atlas with box-drawing U+2500–U+257F
description: Add a second atlas page (or enlarge the grid) in GlyphAtlas::build() to cover Unicode box-drawing characters U+2500 through U+257F (128 chars). These are heavily used by fzf, ncurses, tmux, and neovim for borders and UI chrome. Without this, all box-drawing renders as blank space.

title: P2.1: Apply INVERSE flag in renderer
description: In GunterRenderer::render(), when building CellInstance, check cell.flags.contains(CellFlags::INVERSE) and swap fg/bg values before writing to CellInstance. This fixes fzf selection bar, vim visual mode, bash tab-completion highlights, and any app using SGR 7 (reverse video).

title: P1.4: CPR cursor position report ESC[6n
description: Handle Device Status Report. In csi_dispatch, match action 'n': if param==6, send \x1b[{row+1};{col+1}R via response_tx. fzf, readline, and many TUI apps send \x1b[6n to determine cursor position for layout decisions. Depends on P1.2.

title: P1.3: DA1 response to ESC[c / ESC[0c
description: Handle Primary Device Attributes query. In csi_dispatch, match action 'c' with no intermediate: read param, if 0 or absent, send response \x1b[?62;c back via response_tx. This fixes the fish shell warning: 'could not read response to primary device attribute query'. Depends on P1.2 (write-back channel).

title: P1.2: PTY write-back channel in GridPerformer
description: GridPerformer needs to write response bytes back to PTY master (needed for DA1, CPR). Add response_tx: Option<mpsc::SyncSender<Vec<u8>>> to GridPerformer struct. Update GridPerformer::new() to accept optional sender. In main.rs, pass a clone of pty_tx when constructing GridPerformer during RedrawRequested.

title: P1.1: wrap_next deferred-wrap flag
description: Add wrap_next bool to Grid struct. In GridPerformer::print(), if wrap_next is set, execute line wrap before printing char. Set wrap_next=true when cursor reaches last column and auto_wrap is enabled. Clear wrap_next on any cursor movement CSI. TDD: failing test first — print 80 chars on 80-col grid, cursor at col 79 with wrap_next=true; print one more, cursor at (1,1).

title: Phase 1 Epic: Terminal Protocol Correctness
description: Epic tracking all Phase 1 protocol fixes needed to make TUI apps work correctly. Covers: wrap_next deferred wrap, DA1/CPR responses, ESC M/7/8, application cursor keys, DECAWM, OSC dispatch. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-26-terminal-correctness-design.md.

title: P3.2: Extend atlas with block elements U+2580–U+259F
description: Add block element characters U+2580 through U+259F (32 chars: upper/lower/left/right/quarter blocks, shading chars) to the static atlas. Used by progress bars, file managers, powerline fonts.

title: P2.4: Baseline-align glyphs in atlas
description: In GlyphAtlas::build() glyph placement loop, replace y_off = cell_h.saturating_sub(m.height) with y_off = (ascender - m.ymax as f32).max(0.0) as u32. This places each glyph relative to the shared baseline, fixing vertical character misalignment. Depends on P2.3 (ascender stored in atlas).

title: P2.3: Fix cell height from font metrics
description: In GlyphAtlas::build(), replace cell_h = cell_w * 2 heuristic. Use fontdue font.horizontal_line_metrics(px_size) to get ascender and descender values. cell_h = (ascender + descender.abs()).ceil() as u32. Store ascender in GlyphAtlas struct for use in glyph placement. This fixes misaligned text rows.

title: P1.8: DECAWM auto-wrap mode ?7h/l
description: Add auto_wrap: bool to Grid (default true). Set false on CSI ?7l, true on CSI ?7h. In performer print(), only set wrap_next=true when auto_wrap is enabled. Depends on P1.1.

title: P2.2: Introduce TermColor enum in Grid and performer
description: Replace Color{r,g,b} in Cell with TermColor enum: Default / Indexed(u8) / Rgb(u8,u8,u8). Update Grid::Cell, GridPerformer SGR handler (SGR 39/49 → Default; 30-37/40-47 → Indexed; 38;5 → Indexed; 38;2 → Rgb). Add resolve(palette) method to TermColor that returns (u8,u8,u8). Renderer calls resolve() for each cell. Required for correct INVERSE behavior on default-colored cells.

title: P1.7: Application cursor keys mode ?1h/l
description: Add application_cursor_keys: bool to Grid. Set true on CSI ?1h, false on CSI ?1l. In main.rs translate_key, check grid.application_cursor_keys: if true, send ESC O A/B/C/D for arrow keys instead of ESC [ A/B/C/D. Many apps (vim, emacs) switch to application cursor mode.

title: P1.6: ESC 7/8 save and restore cursor
description: Implement esc_dispatch for ESC 7 (save cursor) and ESC 8 (restore cursor). Store cursor (x, y), current fg, current bg, current flags into Grid::saved_cursor field. Restore on ESC 8. Also support CSI s / CSI u as aliases. Used by vim, tmux, many apps.

title: P1.5: ESC M reverse index
description: Implement esc_dispatch for ESC M (byte 0x4D). Reverse index: move cursor up one line. If cursor is at top of scroll region, scroll content down one line instead (scroll_down(1)). If cursor is above scroll region top, just move cursor up. Used by vim and any app that scrolls backward.

title: Phase 3 Epic: Unicode and Glyph Coverage
description: Epic tracking all Phase 3 glyph work: extend atlas with box-drawing and block-element Unicode ranges, dynamic LRU glyph cache for arbitrary chars, wide char (CJK) support. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-26-terminal-correctness-design.md.

title: Phase 2 Epic: Rendering Correctness
description: Epic tracking all Phase 2 rendering fixes: INVERSE flag application, TermColor enum, font metrics correction, baseline alignment, left bearing, underline rendering. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-26-terminal-correctness-design.md.

title: Phase 2: App keyboard input -> PTY write
description: Handle WindowEvent::KeyboardInput in GunterApp. Translate keys to byte sequences per spec table and write to PTY master writer via channel. Implement full key translation: printable chars, Enter, Backspace, Tab, Ctrl+A-Z, arrows, Ctrl+arrows, F1-F12, Home/End/PgUp/PgDn/Delete.

title: Phase 2: App PTY resize on window resize
description: On WindowEvent::Resized, compute new (cols, rows) from pixel_size / cell_size, then call pty.resize(PtySize). Share PTY master with app state.

title: Phase 2: Performer private modes alternate screen cursor bracketed paste
description: Add CSI ?1049h/l (alternate screen), ?25h/l (cursor visibility), ?2004h/l (bracketed paste) to GridPerformer. Add alt_grid to Grid or Session.

title: Phase 2: Grid scroll region + scroll_up/scroll_down
description: Add scroll_top, scroll_bot, cursor_visible fields to Grid. Implement scroll_up(n) and scroll_down(n) methods that shift rows within the scroll region and push to scrollback.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 2: Performer VTE erase sequences J K
description: Add CSI J (erase display) and CSI K (erase line) sequences to GridPerformer. Cover 0J/1J/2J/3J and 0K/1K/2K variants.

title: Phase 2: Performer VTE scroll/insert/delete sequences
description: Add DECSTBM r, S, T, L, M, @, P, X sequences to GridPerformer. These are required for shell usability (vim, less, etc.).

title: v0.2-app-async: async tokio PTY loop wired to renderer
description: Replace blocking read loop in gunter-app main.rs with async tokio task. PTY reader runs in background task, sends grid updates via mpsc channel to renderer on main thread. winit event loop drives frame timing. Exit condition: WSL shell renders live in wgpu window with Atom One Dark colors.

title: v0.2-renderer-cells: instanced cell quad shader
description: Implement instanced quad rendering for terminal cells. Each cell = one quad with bg/fg color uniforms. Upload only dirty cells from Grid.dirty vec. WGSL shader: vertex positions from cell (col,row), color from instance data. Exit condition: 80x24 grid of colored quads at correct positions.

title: v0.2-renderer-font: fontdue glyph atlas + texture rendering
description: Add fontdue dep. Load embedded ComicShannsMono TTF (or fallback monospace). Build GPU texture atlas. Render glyph textures over cell quads. Exit condition: ASCII chars render with correct font in window.

title: v0.2-renderer-wgpu: wgpu surface + winit window init
description: Add wgpu/winit deps to workspace. Implement GunterRenderer in gunter-renderer: create winit EventLoop, Window, wgpu Instance/Surface/Device/Queue/SwapChain. Clear screen to Atom One Dark background (#282c34) each frame. Exit condition: cargo run opens a blank dark window.

title: v0.1-term: VTE performer with TDD tests
description: Implement GridPerformer in gunter-term/src/performer.rs implementing vte::Perform. TDD: failing tests first. Tests use vte::Parser + GridPerformer with hand-crafted ANSI byte sequences. Cover: plain text print, cursor movement CSI, SGR color codes, newline/CR. cargo test green.

title: v0.1-scaffold: Cargo workspace + crate skeletons
description: Create Cargo.toml workspace root and three crate dirs: gunter-core, gunter-term, gunter-app. Each crate needs its own Cargo.toml with edition=2021 and correct dependencies (vte for gunter-term, portable-pty for gunter-app). No implementation code — just lib.rs/main.rs stubs. cargo check must pass.
close_reason: Cargo workspace + crate skeletons created, cargo check green

title: v0.1-app: PTY loop + main binary
description: Implement gunter-app/src/main.rs: open PTY with portable_pty, spawn wsl.exe, read stdout, drive vte::Parser+GridPerformer per byte, print grid to stdout for headless verification. TDD: integration test that writes ANSI bytes to a mock reader and verifies grid output. cargo test green.

title: v0.1-grid: gunter-core Grid/Cell types with TDD tests
description: Implement Grid, Cell, CellFlags, Color in gunter-core/src/grid.rs. TDD: write failing tests first. API: Grid::new(cols,rows), write_cell(x,y,cell), clear_dirty(), cursor_move(x,y). Tests cover: grid creation, cell write, dirty tracking, cursor movement. cargo test must be green.

title: v0.1.0 Gunter Terminal — WSL shell to grid buffer
description: Implement Phase 1 of Gunter terminal emulator. Goal: echo hello in WSL prints hello in Grid buffer (headless, no GPU). Covers workspace scaffold, Grid/Cell types, VTE performer, PTY loop. Exit condition: cargo test green, grep shows hello in grid output.

title: Ship Windows-native binary with PowerShell installer
description: Cross-platform font loader (embedded JetBrains Mono fallback), GitHub Actions release workflow, install.ps1 one-liner. Unblocks running gunter.exe natively on Windows without WSL.

title: P3.3: Dynamic LRU glyph cache for non-static chars
description: For characters outside the static atlas ranges, implement a dynamic glyph cache: on atlas miss in uv_for_char(), rasterize the glyph with fontdue, append to a dynamic texture region, record UV in a HashMap<char, UVs>. When the dynamic region is full, evict LRU entries (replace with blank). Requires uploading partial texture updates via queue.write_texture. This enables arbitrary Unicode coverage.

title: P2.6: Underline rendering in shader
description: In shader.wgsl fs_main, add underline as a second pass: check if the fragment y position is within the bottom 1-2px of the cell (via uniforms.cell_size.y and frag position within cell). Pass underline flag as a per-instance float bit. Draw underline in fg color when flag is set. Alternatively: render underline as a separate draw call overlay. Simpler: pack flags into CellInstance as u32, test underline bit in shader.

title: P2.5: Apply left bearing (xmin) in glyph placement
description: In GlyphAtlas::build() glyph rasterization loop, add x_off = m.xmin.max(0) as u32 horizontal offset when blitting glyph pixels into the atlas: dst_x = gx + x_off + col. This fixes horizontal glyph position within each cell slot.

title: P1.9: OSC dispatch stub and window title
description: Implement osc_dispatch in GridPerformer (currently missing entirely — unknown OSC sequences may cause parse errors). Handle OSC 0 and OSC 2: set window title by storing in Grid::title: String, and sending winit set_title call via a channel or storing for next frame. All other OSC sequences: silently ignore.

title: P4.2: Focus tracking events ?1004h/l
description: Add focus_reporting: bool to Grid. On CSI ?1004h, set true; on ?1004l, set false. In main.rs WindowEvent::Focused(true/false), if focus_reporting enabled, send \x1b[I (focus in) or \x1b[O (focus out) to PTY. Some editors (vim, neovim) use this to trigger auto-save or redraw on focus change.

title: P4.1: Shift+F-key sequences in translate_key
description: In main.rs translate_key(), add Shift modifier support for F1-F12 keys. Shift+F1=\x1b[1;2P, Shift+F2=\x1b[1;2Q, etc. following XTerm modifier encoding (CSI 1 ; modifier ~). Also add Ctrl+F-key and Alt+F-key variants. Currently all modifier+Fkey combos send nothing.

title: Phase 4 Epic: Input Correctness
description: Epic tracking Phase 4 input fixes: Shift+F-key sequences, focus events, mouse all-motion. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-26-terminal-correctness-design.md.

title: Phase 4: Mouse reporting ?1000h/?1006h
description: Track mouse reporting mode. When ?1000h/?1006h enabled, encode mouse events as ESC[<btn;col;rowM/m and write to PTY.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 4: Mouse scroll + scrollback navigation
description: Handle mouse scroll wheel to navigate scrollback buffer. Render from scrollback when scroll_offset > 0. Add scroll_offset field to app state.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 4: Text selection + clipboard copy/paste
description: Mouse drag selects cell range. Ctrl+Shift+C copies to clipboard via arboard. Ctrl+Shift+V pastes; if ?2004h active wrap in ESC[200~...ESC[201~.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 3: Renderer dirty-only upload
description: Optimize renderer to only upload dirty cells. Skip instances where !grid.dirty[i]. Clear dirty after render.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 3: SGR truecolor 256-color bright colors
description: Add truecolor SGR (38;2;r;g;b / 48;2;r;g;b), 256-color (38;5;n / 48;5;n), and bright colors (SGR 90-97 fg, 100-107 bg) to GridPerformer.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 3: Renderer cursor rendering
description: Render cursor quad at grid.cursor position using theme cursor color (#528bff). Support block/bar/underline styles. DECSCUSR sets cursor style.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: v0.1-smoke: integration smoke test + v0.1.0 tag
description: Final integration: run cargo test --workspace, verify all tests green. Spawn reviewer agent on develop branch. Generate v0.1.0-review.html in ./reports/. Tag v0.1.0 on develop after review passes.

title: P3.4: Wide char (CJK) double-width cell support
description: Add wide: bool to Cell. In performer print(), after writing a wide char, write a Cell{wide_spacer: true} in the next column and advance cursor by 2. In renderer, CellInstance for wide char spans 2 cell_w. In atlas, wide glyphs are rasterized into 2*cell_w slots. Start with detection via unicode_width crate's UnicodeWidthChar::width().

title: P4.3: Mouse all-motion reporting ?1003h/l
description: Add mouse_all_motion: bool to Grid. On CSI ?1003h, set true; ?1003l, set false. In main.rs WindowEvent::CursorMoved, if mouse_all_motion or (mouse_reporting and mouse_pressed), send mouse move event using SGR format: \x1b[<32;col;rowM for motion. Required for apps that track hover position (some TUI apps, mc).

title: Phase 5: Layout tree + pane splits + tabs
description: Add Layout enum (Leaf/Split), Axis, Rect to gunter-core/layout.rs. Implement reflow(). Add Ctrl+Shift+H/V splits and Ctrl+Shift+T/W tabs. Multiple sessions with independent PTY+grid.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 6: Config load + hot reload
description: Add config types (serde+toml). Load ~/.config/gunter/config.toml at startup. Watch with notify crate. On change: re-parse, diff, apply font/theme/key changes.
close_reason: Already implemented and committed in develop branch

title: Phase 7: Socket server (stretch)
description: Add gunter-core/server.rs. Named pipe on Windows (\\.\pipe\gunter-{id}), Unix socket on Linux (/tmp/gunter-{id}.sock). Raw byte stream protocol. gunter attach <id> connects.
